attributes.name: Alchemical Gas
attributes.powers:
If undefeated, display this barrier next to your location.

While displayed, if you start your turn at this location, bury a weapon or armor. Then you may succeed at a Constitution, Fortitude, Intelligence, or Craft 7 check to banish this card.
